assets.name: 钩爪移动·左手牵引滑行
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE opaque full-bleed1000x760 LANDSCAPE game card ARTWORK ONLY. Input1 is USER movement reference: low crouched forward grapple-slide near ground, not its motion blur or realistic scene. Input2 Wylder IDENTITY/equipment ONLY. Input3 original game graphic STYLE ONLY. Visual event: Wylder's anatomical LEFT forearm fires a grappling claw which is now EMBEDDED IN THE GROUND AHEAD; the taut rope pulls him forward in a LOW GROUND SLIDE. Show the ENTIRE cause-and-effect chain in frame: visible LEFT shoulder -> elbow -> extended LEFT armored gauntlet/closed hand -> thin taut metallic rope -> three-pronged hook BITING A HORIZONTAL GROUND SLAB at lower-right. Camera FRONT-LEFT three-quarter, see silver V chest/front and silver helmet facing right. The anatomical LEFT shoulder and LEFT grappling arm are on the VIEWER'S RIGHT of his chest; the RIGHT arm is behind on VIEWER'S LEFT and bent beside torso for balance. ExactlyTWO arms and hands, no extra limbs. LEFT wrist launcher must clearly be attached to LEFT arm, rope exits a little silver launcher aperture on the forearm beside closed brown glove; not a sword, spear, beam or wide blade. Left hand at roughlyx62%y51%, hook atx89%y76% so rope angles DOWN toward ground, NEVER upward offscreen. Keep hook fully readable3-prongs gripping stone, rope fully continuous visibly taut. Knight center-left occupies about65%width: torso inclined forward compressed over low hips, both knees bent, leading boot sliding near front-right, trailing leg folded behind-left, one heel drags a single narrow dust streak BACK to left. He is pulled along the ground, NO airborne leap or swinging from a building. Boots/heel clearly contact same continuous ground plane as hook. Scarf and navy skirt stream behind opposite pull. No monsters. Identity: fully CLOSED silver helmet and silver faceguard, dark eye slit, small metal feather wings, blue panel ONLY helmet side/back. Black scarf, simplified V silver breastplate and asymmetric shoulders, grouped angular scales, brown gloves, deep NAVY split skirt with sparse white flowing motifs, rope-wrapped boots. Small navy round buckler STRAPPED ON BACK, never in shooting hand; right hand empty for balance, do not add a second cable. If sword cannot fit leave it out, no need to show sword. STYLE: graphic flat2D broad angular silhouettes, 2-4 HARD EDGE cel-shaded color planes, bold black negative shapes, exaggerated forearm-to-hook perspective while anatomy clear, no tiny etching or realistic metal. Palette: silver/navy character, warm muted OCHRE stone ground, gray-OLIVE quiet upper background with only2low-contrast horizontal silhouettes. One pale cream highlight on taut rope and little ochre scrape behind heel. Large calm negative space above rope. DIFFERENT from cold-blue explosion cards. No cyan explosions, radial shards, ring halos, airborne debris shower, painterly texture, realistic scenery, blur, UI, text, card frame, cards, logo or watermark.
assets.refinement_prompt: Edit Image1 as the SAME1000x760 landscape graphic game card. Preserve EXACTLY all geometry: low sliding knight pose, anatomical LEFT arm in foreground, attached wrist launcher and closed glove, continuous taut thin cable, three-prong hook anchored on ground at lower-right, right arm behind, legs touching ground, closed helmet identity, buckler on BACK. Change ONLY rendering simplification: make the illustration conform more closely to Image2's original Slay-the-Spire2 flat graphic language. Replace many tiny ground cracks/grass clumps/stone texture with3-4large hard-edged ochre ground planes and only2short scrape marks behind dragging heel. Simplify background ruins into2-3broad LOW-CONTRAST olive-gray silhouettes and a large calm empty field above rope; no little windows/individual bricks. Simplify armor and navy clothing to broad2-4 HARD-EDGE color planes; group scale shapes, remove dense fine etching. Preserve several clear flowing WHITE motifs on NAVY skirt instead of gold embroidery. Do not change the shape or position of any hand, thumb, arm, rope, launcher or anchor. Keep warm muted ochre/olive setting and silver/navy character. No relighting, no glow/radial shards/rings, no added effects or text. Single readable event: a ground-anchored grappling rope pulls the low knight forward in a slide.

pose_check.left_arm: Frontal three-quarter chest: anatomical left arm on screen-right fires a forearm launcher.
pose_check.rope: Fully visible taut thin cable diagonally down-right to hook.
pose_check.anchor: Three-pronged hook fixed on continuous ground at lower-right.
pose_check.feet: Leading boot and trailing leg near ground, forward sliding scrape, no airborne swing.
